notes: Engines that turn the user's own Switch and Switch 2 games into native Mac apps, built on the user's Mac. Nothing is downloaded but the engine's source and its tools; the game, its keys and firmware always come from the user. Each engine is pinned to a commit Retroteca was tested with.

engines.name: nxnative
engines.credit: nxnative by seedds (MIT); the front-end contract follows docs/frontends.md.
